name: OrganizationPolicy
description: Policy for all the users of an organization.

rules.name: OrganizationPolicy-Owner-Rule
rules.description: Allow all the operations on an entity for the owner.

rules.name: OrganizationPolicy-NoOwner-Rule
rules.description: Allow anyone to set the owner of a data asset that has no owner set.

rules.name: OrganizationPolicy-OwnerNoPolicyEdit-Rule
rules.description: Deny owners of a policy changing or deleting it. Admins manage policies.

rules.name: OrganizationPolicy-ViewAll-Rule
rules.description: Allow all users to discover data assets.
